scope: git ls-files providers filtered to .qv and .qcore; includes tracked fixtures and model contracts, not only published production modules
method: lexical regex match of requires resource_premise(NAME, STRING); no comment stripping or loader-derived total is claimed
selection_validation: The selected real production module is loaded and replayed by the Rust controls, which compare its exact original premise statement against frozen census data. This is a bounded selection census, not safety coverage or canonical corpus module/declaration counts.
